test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

HALF ∶ SFOT ∶∶ DAMP ∶ WFNJ ∶∶ AREA ∶ ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : • First and third letters ⇒ Opposite letter according to the English alphabetic series is written. • Second letter ⇒ (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. • Fourth letter ⇒ Opposite letter is written and (1) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series. So, • HALF ∶ SFOT ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4273b6be9b079e876399571b893111baa0f27afee0b4b346383d41082dedf56.png] ​And, • DAMP ∶ WFNJ ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b369a9b26e2c6dc29a29ada75e1e5e2ab992a51072d5bd8068922eccc42b949.png] ​Similarly, • AREA ∶ ? ​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4203d38b7a7871f7e25a211784304428f6252f4adc48065a9732e1e593839394.png] ​Hence, "**ZWVY**" is the correct answer. 51:T110f,
